user.title: Connect to Yunkan
user.description: Enter the address of your Yunkan server. Use the nginx entry (usually port 23406), not an internal port. You sign in on the server itself in the next step.

data.use_password: Sign in with a username and password instead

data_description.base_url: The server's main entry address, including the port (usually 23406).
data_description.verify_ssl: Turn off for a self-signed certificate on your LAN
data_description.use_password: Use this when your browser cannot open the Yunkan authorization page — a certificate it refuses, or a server it cannot reach from here.

handoff.title: Authorize Home Assistant
handoff.description: The Yunkan sign-in page opens in a new window. Sign in the way you normally do and press Authorize; this page carries on by itself. If the window does not open, or the page will not load, close this dialog and start again with “Sign in with a username and password instead” ticked.

credentials.title: Sign in to Yunkan
credentials.description: Sign in to {base_url} with a Yunkan account and password. An account with two-step verification turned on cannot sign in this way — it has to be authorized on the Yunkan page instead, which older servers do not have.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authorize Yunkan
reauth_confirm.description: Home Assistant needs permission for {base_url} again. Continue to sign in on the Yunkan server.

data.use_password: Sign in with a username and password instead

data_description.use_password: Use this when your browser cannot open the Yunkan authorization page — a certificate it refuses, or a server it cannot reach from here.

reauth_password.title: Re-authenticate Yunkan
reauth_password.description: Enter the current password for {username} on {base_url}.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect. Check the server URL and that the server is running.
error.mfa_required: This account uses two-step verification, which a password on its own cannot complete. Go back and leave “Sign in with a username and password instead” unticked, so you can authorize on the Yunkan page.
error.setup_required: The Yunkan server has not finished its first-run setup. Open the Yunkan web interface and create an admin account, then try again.
error.no_url: Home Assistant does not know its own address, so Yunkan cannot send you back here. Set the internal or external address under Settings > System > Network, then try again.
error.handoff_failed: Authorization failed. The code may have expired — try again.
error.access_denied: Authorization was cancelled on the Yunkan page.

abort.already_configured: This Yunkan server is already configured.
abort.single_instance_allowed: Only one Yunkan server can be configured.

ptz.name: PTZ control
ptz.description: Moves a pan/tilt/zoom camera in a direction for a short time.

direction.name: Direction
direction.description: The direction to move the camera.

duration.name: Duration
duration.description: How long to move before stopping, in seconds. Use 0 to keep moving until another command.

preset.name: Preset
preset.description: Go to a named preset position.

tts_broadcast.name: Voice broadcast
tts_broadcast.description: Speaks a message on the camera's speaker using text-to-speech (Pro).

voice.name: Voice
voice.description: Optional voice name; leave empty for the server default.

snapshot.name: Take snapshot
snapshot.description: Captures a fresh snapshot from the camera and saves it to a file.

filename.name: File name
filename.description: Full path to write the JPEG to. The folder must be in allowlist_external_dirs.

export.name: Export recording
export.description: Exports a recording for a time range to a downloadable clip.

start.name: Start
start.description: Start of the range to export.

end.name: End
end.description: End of the range to export.

pro_required.title: Yunkan Pro required
pro_required.description: This action needs a Yunkan Pro license, but the server is on the free tier (status: {status}). AI detection and voice broadcast remain unavailable until the server is upgraded.

embed_not_admin.title: Sidebar panel: server switch not enabled
embed_not_admin.description: The sidebar panel is enabled, but the integration could not switch on “Allow embedding in Home Assistant” on the Yunkan server — the configured account has no admin rights. Signing in inside the panel will keep looping until you enable the switch manually in the web console (Settings → remote live view → advanced) or reconfigure the integration with an admin account.

embed_server_unsupported.title: Sidebar panel: server update required
embed_server_unsupported.description: The sidebar panel is enabled, but the connected Yunkan server does not have the “Allow embedding in Home Assistant” setting yet. Signing in inside the panel will not work until the server is updated.

init.title: Options
init.description: Event image rendering and the optional sidebar panel. Changes apply immediately.

data.snapshot_bounding_box: Draw detection boxes on event images
data.snapshot_crop: Crop event images around the detected object
data.sidebar_panel: Show the Yunkan web console in the sidebar
data.panel_url: Web console address for the panel (optional)

data_description.snapshot_bounding_box: Boxes are drawn on the snapshot by the server, like in the event center.
data_description.snapshot_crop: Zooms in on the detected object with some context around it — handy for notification previews.
data_description.sidebar_panel: Embeds the web console as a sidebar panel and automatically switches on “Allow embedding in Home Assistant” on the server (admin account required). Your browser must be able to reach the address directly; when Home Assistant uses HTTPS the console must be HTTPS too.
data_description.panel_url: Leave empty to use the connection address. Set it when the panel should open a different address, e.g. your HTTPS domain.
